confidence_notes: Chiang Rai food and drink anchors use Numbeo prices last updated 2026-10-02, based on only 18 contributors in the past 18 months. Cocktail and wine-glass prices are estimated at about three and four times the local domestic draft-beer price because direct city-specific prices were unavailable. Accommodation anchors are broad holistic estimates; no live booking pages or current listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and coffee use Chiang Rai city-specific typical prices. For accommodation, the estimate reflects a modest northern Thai provincial tourist city, with Chiang Mai as a qualitative nearby comparison and an allowance for Chiang Rai's lower tourism scale.
